name: Commissioning equipment and consumables
description: Commissioning equipment and consumables for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Commissioning. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: Shell Mysella S5 N 40 / Shell Mysella  — SAE viscosity class (approved engine oil, Series 4000 and 400 gas engines)
specifications.basis: MTU Fluids and Lubricants Specifications A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Tables 5/6/10/12: Shell Mysella S5 N 40 and S3 N 40 listed with SAE viscosity class 40 for generator/marine gas-engine applications; general rule 'Viscosity grade SAE 40 is stipulated for gas engines. Multigrade oils are not permitted.'

specifications.metric: Castrol Duratec L / ExxonMobil Mobil P — SAE viscosity class for listed approved/alternative oils
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Tables 5, 6, 10 and 12: Castrol Duratec L, Mobil Pegasus 705/805/1005 and MTU GEO NG Power X2L all listed at SAE viscosity class 40; some alternative oils noted '* The use of these engine oils shortens the service life.'

specifications.metric: ANTIFREEZE / corrosion inhibitor and A — permissible ethylene-glycol antifreeze concentration
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 17: ethylene glycol antifreeze min 35% to max 50% by volume, with protection to -20 C / -25 C / -31 C / -37 C at 35/40/45/50%; above 50% impermissible. Section 5.2 of the same document covers 'NOx reducing agent AUS 32 for SCR exhaust gas aftertreatment systems'.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D post-commissioning filter pac — number of standardised spare parts packages
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D' printed June 2022: four packages - post-commissioning (filters for complete replacement after commissioning), mechanical (lube oil/fuel/air filters, gaskets, spare fuel injector), after-treatment (urea filters, injectors, NOx sensors), automation (speed/pressure/float/temperature sensors).

specifications.metric: Gas-engine lubricating oil and use — viscosity grade stipulated for gas engines
specifications.basis: MTU Fluids and Lubricants Specifications A001072/02E, 2020-06, section 2.1.1: 'Viscosity grade SAE 40 is stipulated for gas engines. Multigrade oils are not permitted.' Mixing different engine oils is strictly prohibited.

specifications.metric: Gas-engine lubricating oil and use — oil sample interval, Series 4000 gas engines
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E, 2020-06, sections 2.2.1/2.2.2: 'To determine the engine oil change intervals, oil samples must be taken every 250 op. hrs. and analyzed. The limit values must be observed.' Fixed intervals without oil analysis only after consultation with MTU.

specifications.metric: Gas-engine lubricating oil and use — used gas engine oil viscosity at 100 C, Series 4000
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E, 2020-06, Table 2 'Limit values for used gas engine oils SAE 40': Viscosity at 100 °C (ASTM D445 / DIN 51562), Series 4000 Max. 17.5, Min. 11.5, with new-oil value condition.

specifications.metric: Gas-engine lubricating oil and use — water in used gas engine oil
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E, 2020-06, Table 2: Water (ASTM D6304 / EN 12937 / ISO 6296), Max. 0.2 % by vol. for both Series 4000 and Series 400.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D commissioning and post-co — post-commissioning package content
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', printed June 2022, p.6: 'This package includes various relevant filters for a complete replacement after the commissioning. The engine will start service with a fresh set of filters, which will ensure the best possible start.'

specifications.metric: MAN 175D commissioning and post-co — mechanical package contents
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.6: 'filters for lubrication oil, fuel and air', relevant gaskets for valve clearance adjustment, plus a spare fuel injector.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D commissioning and post-co — after-treatment package contents
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.6: 'urea filters, spare urea injectors and the important NOx sensors'.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D commissioning and post-co — automation package contents
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', June 2022, p.6: 'a selection of different sensors - speed, pressure, float switch and temperature'.

specifications.basis: 'Viscosity grade SAE 40 is stipulated for gas engines. Multigrade oils are not permitted.' Also 'Mixing different engine oils is strictly prohibited.' A001072/02E 2020-06, p.7
specifications.value: Viscosity grade SAE 40 is stipulated for gas engines. Multigrade oils are not permitted.

specifications.metric: Oil sample frequency for change-interval determination
specifications.basis: 'To determine the engine oil change intervals, oil samples must be taken every 250 op. hrs. and analyzed. The limit values must be observed.' A001072/02E 2020-06, pp.14-15

specifications.metric: Used gas engine oil viscosity at 100 C - Series 4000
specifications.basis: Table 2 'Limit values for used gas engine oils SAE 40': viscosity at 100 C ASTM D445/DIN 51562, Series 4000 Max. 17.5; also Min. 11.5 and 'New oil value +30 %'. A001072/02E 2020-06, p.8

specifications.metric: Used gas engine oil total base number (TBN) - Series 4000
specifications.basis: Table 2: TBN ASTM D2896/ISO 3771, Series 4000 Min. 2.5 and TBN > TAN; 'New oil value -60 %'. A001072/02E 2020-06, p.8

specifications.metric: Used gas engine oil water - both series
specifications.basis: Table 2: Water ASTM D6304/EN 12937/ISO 6296, Max. 0.2 for Series 4000 and Series 400. A001072/02E 2020-06, p.8

specifications.metric: Used gas engine oil wear metals - iron
specifications.basis: Table 2: Iron (Fe) DIN 51399-1/-2 Max. 30 (Series 4000) / Max. 50 (Series 400); Pb 20/30; Al 10/20; Cu 20*/50; Sn 5/15; Si 15*/10. *Si only for natural gas; first oil change (max 3000 op.hrs) Cu limit 50 ppm. A001072/02E 2020-06, p.8

specifications.metric: Silicon operational limit SiBG - with catalytic exhaust gas cleaning
specifications.basis: Section 2.1.3: 'Operation SiBG: With catalytic exhaust gas cleaning 0; Without catalytic exhaust gas cleaning < 0.01 (Series 4000); < 0.02 (Series 400).' SiB = Delta Si [ppm] x (Oil fill + top-up)[l] / generated electrical work [kWh]. A001072/02E 2020-06, p.10

gaps.why: No published prices, drum sizes for this site, diesel volume or chemical quantities for commissioning of the 7-unit plant were found. MTU and MAN print specifications only; Shell's product page did not render usable text through WebFetch, so no Shell-page figures are recorded.
gaps.next_action: Obtain priced consumables list and confirm which OEM oil approval applies to the actual engine make.

gaps.why: No printed price, RM amount or supplier quotation for commissioning lube oil, diesel, chemical, filters or NOx reducing agent was found. MTU A001072/02E (2020-06) and the MAN 175D brochure (June 2022) print specifications and package contents only; the data in the MAN brochure is stated non-binding.
gaps.next_action: Request priced consumables quantities from the bidder; keep the SAE 40, 250-hour sampling and package contents as specifications, not prices.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
